parrafo_1.es: South FL Catering at The Events Center es un salón de eventos y catering en Margate, FL. Familias, iglesias y empresas lo eligen para baby showers, aniversarios, conferencias y presentaciones, con espacio de sobra y estacionamiento amplio.
parrafo_1.en: South FL Catering at The Events Center is an event venue and catering business in Margate, FL. Families, churches and companies choose it for baby showers, anniversaries, conferences and showcases, with plenty of room and ample parking.

parrafo_2.es: El personal ofrece un recorrido por las instalaciones, incluida el área de preparación: no se cocina dentro del salón, pero cuentan con hot boxes, refrigeradores y mesas para mantener el banquete listo y caliente durante todo el evento.
parrafo_2.en: Staff walk you through the facility, including the prep area: cooking is not done on site, but they have warming boxes, refrigerators and tables to keep the banquet ready and hot through the whole event.

texto.es: Cuéntanos la fecha, el tipo de evento y cuántos invitados esperas: baby shower, aniversario, conferencia o celebración familiar.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the type of event and how many guests you expect: baby shower, anniversary, conference or family celebration.

titulo.en: We walk the venue with you

texto.es: Conoces el espacio, el área de banquete y las salas disponibles, como el salón Onyx, antes de decidir.
texto.en: You see the space, the banquet area and the rooms available, like the Onyx room, before deciding.

texto.es: Te damos el precio del salón y del catering según el número de invitados y lo que necesite tu evento.
texto.en: We give you the price for the venue and the catering based on your guest count and what your event needs.

texto.es: Llegas y todo está listo: mesas, sillas y el banquete caliente en los hot boxes, para que solo te ocupes de disfrutar.
texto.en: You arrive and everything is ready: tables, chairs and the banquet kept hot in the warming boxes, so all you have to do is enjoy it.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según el número de invitados y el menú. Escríbenos sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guest count and menu. Message us, no strings attached.

texto.es: Salones amplios como el Onyx para una celebración cómoda, con espacio de sobra para tus invitados.
texto.en: Spacious rooms like the Onyx room for a comfortable celebration, with plenty of room for your guests.

texto.es: Desde aniversarios pastorales hasta reuniones familiares grandes, con asientos cómodos y fácil acceso.
texto.en: From pastoral anniversaries to large family gatherings, with comfortable seating and easy access.

texto.es: Workshops, seminarios y presentaciones para productores y conferencistas, con filas de asientos listas.
texto.en: Workshops, seminars and showcases for producers and speakers, with rows of seating ready to go.

texto.es: Hot boxes, refrigeradores y mesas de servicio para mantener el banquete listo y caliente durante todo el evento.
texto.en: Warming boxes, refrigerators and service tables to keep the banquet ready and hot through the whole event.

pie.es: ¿Tu evento es distinto? Escríbenos igual, seguro lo podemos acomodar.
pie.en: Is your event different? Message us anyway, we can likely make it work.

items.quote: We had our Leader's Apostle John L. Mohorn Jr & Elect Lady Delbert Mohorn 30 year Pastoral Anniversary. The Word Of The Living God Ministries. The Place was the prefect location, to host this event, the seating was comfortable, the place was well maintained. And the location was easy to find.

I had my baby shower here, invited about 60 people and used the Onyx room. I loved the entire experience the facility lobby is so lovely! My room was nice and spacious! My guest loved the place. Michael has some of the BEST customer service I have ever experienced he is super informative and reliable. Thank you guys for the wonderful experience!
Hosted my event at the event center for the first time. Great, spacious area. Plenty of parking, and ready to go.

This place is well maintained. The staff took the time to give us a tour of the facility including the food preparation area. Cooking isn't allowed but they have hot boxes with warming capabilities, refrigerators and tables.
